request.system:
You extract project issues from documents about building grid-scale battery storage sites.
Return JSON that matches the schema exactly.

Definitions and rules:
- An issue is a risk, problem, delay, unanswered dependency, constraint or past incident that affects or could affect programme, cost or handover. Work that is simply complete is not an issue.
- Return one mention per distinct issue in this document. Do not merge unrelated issues. Do not split one issue into several.
- title: at most 10 words, neutral wording, no project name.
- description: one or two plain sentences.
- counterparty_role: who the issue depends on or was caused by. Use one of: DNO, civils contractor, contractor, transformer supplier, LPA, landowner, internal. Use null if none is clear.
- status: open = unresolved as of this document; resolved = the document says it is done or closed; materialised = it has now caused a programme slip or a confirmed adverse date; occurred = a past incident described for the record or as a lesson.
- awaiting_third_party: true if the team is waiting on a response or deliverable from someone outside the project team.
- chase_count: the number of chases or requests the document states for this issue, otherwise null.
- programme_impact: realised if a slip has happened, potential if the document says it could affect the programme, otherwise none_stated.
- triggers: only when the document states a condition or deadline after which the issue becomes critical or the programme is at risk. condition_text must be copied from the document. Resolve deadline_date to yyyy-mm-dd using the document date 2025-02-07: a month name means the last day of that month; "within N weeks" means the document date plus N weeks; "autumn" means 1 September of that year. If it cannot be resolved, use null.
- evidence_quote: copy an exact, contiguous piece of the document text, at most 200 characters, that supports the mention. Do not paraphrase.
- programme: fill only values the document states. Dates as yyyy-mm-dd. Use null otherwise.
request.user:
Document date: 2025-02-07
Project: drumgarve
Document type: procurement_issue

---
DRUMGARVE BESS - PROCUREMENT ISSUE

Date raised: 2025-02-07
Raised by: Procurement
Project: Drumgarve (40MW)

Main transformer lead time has been revised by the supplier from
38 weeks to 54 weeks. Notified by email 05/02, no advance warning.

This pushes delivery from September 2025 to January 2026.

IMPACT
Energisation forecast moves from Nov 2025 to Mar 2026, a slip of
approximately 16 weeks. Drumgarve does not currently hold a
capacity market agreement so the direct revenue exposure is lower
than it would be at Ashfield, but we lose a winter of trading
revenue.

OPTIONS CONSIDERED
1. Accept the revised date
2. Source from an alternative supplier - lead times quoted
   between 45 and 60 weeks, so no benefit
3. Second-hand / ex-stock unit - one identified, specification
   does not match

RECOMMENDATION
Accept and replan. Also: this is the second transformer lead time
extension from this supplier in 14 months (see Netherwood, Dec
2023). We should stop treating their quoted lead times as firm
and build contingency into the programme at the point of order,
not when they tell us.

---
